_about: Seeds for the auto story maker: a small gully-cricket situation each. The maker picks one at random so the stories differ. Add more lines any time.
situations: the ball is stuck in a tree
the wicket is a school bag and someone moves it
power cut and the game goes on in the dark
a cow walks onto the pitch
the umpire falls asleep
new bat that is too heavy for the kid
rain starts just as someone is about to win
mother calls for dinner in the middle of the last over
the ball lands in a neighbour's courtyard
a kite string catches the ball
two kids both claim the toss was theirs
the scoreboard is chalk on a wall and it gets rubbed off
someone brought a very old torn ball
a bee comes near the batter
the kid with the helmet cannot see anything
someone sells ice cream and the whole team forgets the match
the bat breaks on the very first shot
a kid wears shoes two sizes too big
the dog steals the ball and runs
somebody says the ball touched the wall so it is four
a kid pretends to be a commentator on a stick microphone
the shortest kid has to bowl against the tallest
the team captain forgets his own name in the team list
a kid says he can play with his eyes closed
the ball goes into the water tank
the match is stopped for a wedding band passing by
a kid keeps running after the ball already stopped
someone is afraid of the fast bowler and hides behind the wicket
grandfather tells an old story and everyone forgets the game
the pitch is wet and a kid slips
someone brings homework to the match
a kid argues about whose turn is next
the last ball and everyone is nervous but the ball is a dud
a kid wears his father's big cap
someone lost the whistle
a new kid joins and plays better than everyone
the neighbour's pigeon sits on the wicket
a kid tries a secret fancy shot he saw on TV
everyone says the same excuse for getting out
the ball is lost and a kid pretends to find it
a kid brings a very tiny bat
the umpire's decision is announced in a funny way
a kid keeps score wrongly on purpose
somebody runs the wrong way after a shot
a very long wait because the ball went far away
someone brings snacks and the game becomes a picnic
a kid tries to teach the dog how to field
a kid wants to bat first and cries a fake cry
the sun is so hot that the kids play under a tree
a team makes a funny secret code word
